channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio diz que Bolsonaro falou para ele ficar firme e descartou Michelle como opção
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for President, stated that former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) encouraged him to 'stay firm' following the disclosure of his conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. Flávio ruled out Michelle Bolsonaro as an alternative for the presidential ticket, reinforcing his own name as the Bolsonaro clan's preferred candidate.

item.title: O sinal de alerta por empresários após caso envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: The leaked audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro demanded payments from banker Daniel Vorcaro — involved in Brazil’s largest financial fraud scandal — triggered strong negative reactions among business leaders at Brazilian Week in NY. Executives began questioning Flávio’s electoral viability and considering alternatives to his candidacy, while Bolsonaro allies view the episode as a dangerous source of political wear for the family. The strategy of linking Flávio to Vorcaro, dubbed “BolsoMaster” by Lula government allies, is emerging as a key weapon for opponents in the 2026 election.

item.title: Ex-ministro de Bolsonaro lança livro com uso de IA; poucos aliados presentes
item.description: Former Health Minister Marcelo Queiroga launched his autobiography at the Federal Senate Library, tracing his journey from the Paraíba backcountry to his pandemic-era leadership. The event was sparsely attended amid media focus on the alleged relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro. The book features AI-generated illustrations, including one depicting Queiroga with vaccines in front of a cart bearing PT symbols, sparking controversy.

item.title: Crusoé: As múltiplas frentes da crise que Flávio Bolsonaro precisa administrar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces an electoral viability crisis, as retaining his Bolsonarist base is not enough to prevent erosion among non-Bolsonarist voters, lowering his electoral ceiling and favoring Lula. The absence of a 'victory aura' drives away political and financial support, worsening his position. The revelation of additional unspecified elements multiplies the fronts of crisis he must manage.

item.title: As mudanças nas versões de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre sua ligação com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro admitted to negotiating with banker Daniel Vorcaro of Master Investments to finance the filming of a movie, contradicting his previous denials of any connection between his family, the far right, and Vorcaro. He had previously dismissed such links as a 'false narrative created by Lula'.

item.title: Gleisi cobra reação de Moro e Dallagnol aos áudios enviados por Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro: 'Silêncio ensurdecedor'
item.description: Former minister Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) criticized the silence of Sergio Moro and Deltan Dallagnol regarding audio messages in which Flávio Bolsonaro requested money from Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, calling the omission 'deafening'. She and former governor Roberto Requião questioned the stance of PL allies in Paraná, accusing them of complicity in potential wrongdoing. While Moro and Filipe Barros reposted Flávio’s defense, Dallagnol shared a post by Nikolas Ferreira denying premature condemnations.

item.title: Secretário do MinC fala de Flavio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro sem Lei Rouanet
item.description: The executive secretary of Brazil's Ministry of Culture, Marcio Tavares, criticized Flavio Bolsonaro's request for R$ 134 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro, noting that the approach — seeking funds privately without transparency — contrasts with the Lei Rouanet's principles of accountability and fundraising limits. He stated that national cinema and the Rouanet law are grateful not to be associated with this 'horror story'.

item.title: Pai de Daniel Vorcaro doou R$ 1 milhão a diretório do Partido Novo em MG quando Zema era candidato
item.description: Henrique Vorcaro, father of banker Daniel Vorcaro, donated R$1 million to the Minas Gerais state directory of the Novo Party in 2022, when Romeu Zema was running for re-election. Zema stated the donation went to the party, not his campaign, and that no funds entered his election effort. Henrique Vorcaro was arrested in Operation Compliance Zero, linked to investigations into Banco Master.

item.title: Assessora trabalhou em filme de Bolsonaro enquanto recebia da Câmara
item.description: Rareska Metsker, an aide to federal deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) and employed as a parliamentary secretary in the Chamber of Deputados, worked as an executive producer on the film 'Dark Horse' between October and November 2023, dedicating seven weeks to filming while receiving a public salary. She shared her involvement on social media, presenting herself as responsible for the film’s making-of, before deleting the posts after being contacted by the report. The Chamber of Deputados stated that parliamentary secretaries may engage in other activities outside work hours, as the role does not require exclusive dedication.

item.title: O que significa ser ‘persona non-grata’, como deputados do Rio encaram Fábio Porchat
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro State Legislature's Constitution and Justice Committee declared comedian Fábio Porchat persona non-grata by a 4-2 vote, following a proposal by Deputy Rodrigo Amorim (PL), who claimed Porchat disrespected Christian values and the image of Jair Bolsonaro. The measure is symbolic, as Porchat is a Brazilian citizen without diplomatic immunity, so he will face no legal penalties.

item.title: Após vazamento de áudio a Vorcaro, Flávio viaja para entregar fuzis
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) traveled to Rio de Janeiro to attend a ceremony delivering rifles and bulletproof vests to the state police, following the leak of audio in which he demanded sponsorship from banker Daniel Vorcaro for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. He confirmed requesting the payment but denied receiving illegal benefits, stating it was a private request for a private film about his father. The trip, originally scheduled for Wednesday, was postponed due to the controversy sparked by the leaked messages.

item.title: O novo posicionamento de Caiado sobre áudio de Flávio para Vorcaro: ‘Fundamental é derrotar o PT’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former governor of Goiás and presidential candidate, initially demanded transparency from Flávio Bolsonaro regarding an audio in which he demanded payments from Banco Master to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Later, Caiado downplayed the incident as a "personal fault," stressing that defeating the PT in the 2026 elections and maintaining center-right unity is the top priority. He emphasized that individual controversies should not distract from the goal of defeating Lula.

item.title: Cabeleira, olhos verdes: quem interpreta a família Bolsonaro em 'Dark Horse', filme patrocinado por Vorcaro
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', funded by banker Daniel Vorcaro with R$ 62 million, portrays the Bolsonaro family with international and Brazilian actors, including Jim Caviezel as Jair Bolsonaro. Set for release on September 11, 2025, the movie sparked controversy after Senator Flavio Bolsonaro was revealed to have requested funds from Vorcaro for its financing, shortly before the election.

item.title: Áudio de Flávio com Vorcaro e críticas de Zema incendeiam aliança entre PL e Novo em SC
item.description: Criticisms from Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais and leader of the Novo party, directed at Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL party over audio recordings revealing negotiations with businessman Daniel Vorcaro, have strained the alliance between the two parties in Santa Catarina. The audio content, suggesting questionable dealings, was used by Zema to challenge Flávio’s integrity, undermining trust between PL and Novo in the state. The subscriber-exclusive report warns the incident could jeopardize future electoral coordination between the parties in SC.

item.title: Falta de creche pesa na renda e na carreira das mães
item.description: The lack of daycare spots in Brazil directly impacts mothers’ income and careers, especially low-income mothers who rely more on informal support. While higher-income families hire private babysitters, lower-income families depend on grandparents, neighbors, or domestic workers, reinforcing gender and class inequalities. This gap reduces mothers’ labor force participation, with 65.2% employed in Q4 2023 versus 73.2% of childless women, according to FGV-IBRE.

item.title: Partido Novo, de Zema, recebeu R$ 1 mi de pai de Vorcaro em 2022
item.description: The Novo Party received a R$ 1 million donation from Henrique Vorcaro, father of Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, during the 2022 elections. Party pre-candidate Romeu Zema harshly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for soliciting funds from Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', calling it 'imperdoável' and inconsistent with anti-corruption rhetoric.

item.title: 'Caras renomadíssimos': Quem são o ator e o diretor citados por Flávio Bolsonaro em pedido de dinheiro a Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested financier Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, emphasizing the need to pay actor Jim Caviezel and director Cyrus Nowrasteh on time, whom he called 'world-renowned'. He warned that failing to pay could undermine the film's expected positive impact. Caviezel is an American actor known for roles in films such as 'The Count of Monte Cristo' and 'The Thin Red Line'.

item.title: Candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro vale tanto quanto CDB do Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy is viewed as high-risk due to suspicions of involvement in the 'rachadinha' scheme, ties to militias, and ownership of a R$6 million mansion. Even among skeptics, few expected the political investment in his campaign to yield so little — comparable to the low return of a Master CDB. The situation reflects disappointment and scrutiny over his electoral viability amid recurring controversies.

item.title: É apenas um celular de Vorcaro que está 'entregando tudo' à PF
item.description: The Federal Police obtained the central evidence in the Master case operations from the forensic analysis of a single cellphone belonging to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. The audio recordings and conversations with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, which underpin the investigation, were extracted from this device. The revelation underscores how a single phone played a pivotal role in uncovering the alleged scheme.

item.title: Apostas em Flávio Bolsonaro caem após áudio vazado
item.description: Betting odds for Flávio Bolsonaro defeating Lula in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election declined on Polymarket after leaked audio surfaced showing him negotiating R$134 million to finance a documentary about Jair Bolsonaro. His chances dropped from 42.5% to 33.1% between May 13 and 14, while Lula rose to 43%. Romeu Zema emerged as a right-wing alternative, increasing from 3.6% to 9% in betting markets.

item.title: 'Problema seu': Zema responde a críticas de Eduardo e Carlos Bolsonaro após reação a áudios de Flávio para Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president, responded to criticism from allies of Flávio Bolsonaro after calling the senator's audio messages to banker Daniel Vorcaro 'a slap in the face'. Carlos Bolsonaro accused him of 'going beyond all limits', while Eduardo Bolsonaro called him 'vile' for exploiting the situation. Zema replied on X: 'for those who don't know how to distinguish opportunism from coherence: the problem is yours'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro precisa se explicar diante dessas gravações, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) must explain himself regarding audio recordings in which he requests money from Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. Caiado reiterated that the right's goal remains defeating Lula in the 2026 elections, emphasizing the need for unity within the center-right. He added that personal shortcomings should be addressed individually, following Flávio Bolsonaro's claim that his contacts with Vorcaro were solely for private film sponsorship and his call for a CPI to investigate alleged fraud at Banco Master.

item.title: 'Flávio Bolsonaro acabou' e 'frenesi vai durar pouco': as reações de políticos aos áudios entre senador e banqueiro do Master
item.description: Politicians from different factions reacted to leaked audio between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, in which Bolsonaro sought funding for a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. PSD pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado called for full transparency in public-private relations and stressed the importance of center-right unity to defeat the PT. Meanwhile, Mission Party pre-candidate Renan Santos declared 'Flávio Bolsonaro is over' and argued that all involved in the Banco Master scandal — including Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes — should face legal consequences.

item.title: Eduardo diz que pai de Vorcaro doou R$ 1 milhão para partido de Zema
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro highlighted a R$1 million donation from Henrique Moura Vorcaro, father of Daniel Vorcaro, to the New Party to attack presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema, who had criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for requesting funds from Vorcaro to finance the 'Dark Horse' film. The donation came amid the sixth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which led to Vorcaro’s arrest. Eduardo accused Zema of hypocrisy, claiming he is doing the same thing he criticizes in the PT by accepting money from investigated sources.

item.title: Lançamento de autobiografia de ex-ministro de Bolsonaro ‘flopa’ após bomba sobre Flávio
item.description: Former Health Minister Marcelo Queiroga's autobiography launch at the Senate flopped after reports emerged that Flávio Bolsonaro had requested R$61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Expected to draw dozens of Bolsonaro supporters, the event saw minimal attendance as many avoided the Senate or met with Flávio to manage the fallout.

item.title: Por que a ligação de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro afeta o Ibovespa
item.description: Reports that Flávio Bolsonaro sought funds from Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master — implicated in Brazil’s largest banking fraud, with estimated losses of R$ 52 billion — triggered a sharp negative market reaction. Following the Intercept’s report, the Ibovespa fell 1.80% to its lowest level since March 20, while the EWZ declined 0.69% in pre-market trading and the dollar rose above R$ 5. The episode raised investor concerns about the viability of Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 candidacy, particularly due to his association with a scandal that undermined pension funds and financial system confidence.

item.title: Zema irrita ala bolsonarista após criticar Flávio: "Fraude da direita"
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and 2026 presidential pre-candidate, sparked a backlash from Bolsonaro allies after calling Flávio Bolsonaro’s alleged extortion of banker Daniel Vorcaro 'imperdoável.' Bolsonaro-aligned figures such as Cristiano Caporezzo, Rogério Marinho, and Gustavo Gayer accused Zema of opportunism, electoral desperation, and being a 'fraud of the right,' undermining his effort to position himself as a competitive right-wing alternative for 2026.

item.title: Zema reage após ser chamado de oportunista por criticar Flávio
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pré-candidate for President under the Novo party, reacted after being called an 'opportunist' by allies of Flávio Bolsonaro for harshly criticizing the senator’s request for money from banker Daniel Vorcaro. Zema defended his stance as consistent with his public morality campaign, stating he would not defend Flávio despite past Bolsonaro alignment, and threatened to abandon his pré-candidacy if he had to 'be just another one'. The Minas Gerais right is divided, with some shielding Flávio and others, like Zema, aligning with left-wing criticism of the senator’s conduct.

item.title: Flávio tem 50% e Lula, 43% no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 50% voting intention against 43% for Lula in a potential second-round scenario, according to a Gerp poll released on May 14, 2026. The poll also showed a technical tie between the two in the first round. The margin of error is 2.24 percentage points, with a 95.5% confidence level.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 54% e aprovado por 40%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on May 14, 2026, shows 54.0% of Brazilians disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) government, while 40.0% approve. Negative evaluation is strong, with 47.0% rating the administration as 'bad' or 'terrible', compared to 32.0% who see it as 'good' or 'excellent'. The survey of 2,000 people conducted from May 8–12 has a 2.24 percentage point margin of error and is registered with the TSE under BR-03369/2026.

item.title: UNE vê retrocesso em veto de Lula e cobra mudanças na Lei do Estágio
item.description: The National Union of Students (UNE) criticized President Lula's veto of bill 2.762/2019, which aimed to recognize internships as professional experience. The organization states that millions of young people are subjected to abusive work hours, low stipends, and lack of basic rights in the name of training, calling the veto a setback for student rights.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e a confissão em vídeo de relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was exposed by a leaked audio from Intercept Brasil in which he requests financial support from banker Daniel Vorcaro, described by Ricardo Noblat as a 'cinematic rachadão'. In a video defending himself, the senator adopts a pleading tone, promising eternal loyalty to Vorcaro, which Noblat interprets as an implicit confession of an improper relationship. The analysis suggests Flávio underestimates voter intelligence by attempting to normalize the request as a 'private investment'.

item.title: Mídia internacional aponta "crise" após áudios entre Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the right-wing presidential pre-candidate, admitted to requesting funds from imprisoned banker Daniel Vorcaro—accused of billion-dollar frauds at Banco Master—to finance a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. International media, including Argentina’s La Nación, labeled the scandal a crisis threatening his pre-campaign, citing negotiations of up to US$24 million and R$61 million already disbursed between February and May 2025. The episode undermines his transparency rhetoric amid polling ties with Lula, signaling a deeper unraveling of Bolsonarist momentum.

item.title: Lula é rejeitado por 49% e Flávio, por 41%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on May 14, 2026, shows that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has a 49% rejection rate among Brazilian voters, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has a 41% rejection rate. Conducted between May 8–12 with 2,000 respondents, the survey predates the audio scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro asking Daniel Vorcaro for money and carries a 2.24 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Negócio com Master semeia dúvidas sobre a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro faces scrutiny after reports emerged that he received R$61 million from Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, allegedly to finance a private film about Jair Bolsonaro. The film’s production company denied any involvement of Vorcaro or his entities in the project, deepening the mystery around the funds’ use. The controversy casts doubt on his presidential candidacy for the Liberal Party amid ongoing Federal Police investigations and allegations of ties to financial fraud.

item.title: Do tio Queiroz ao irmão Vorcaro, a evolução de Flávio Bolsonaro, o Tarantino tupiniquim
item.description: The text discusses Flávio Bolsonaro's political trajectory, highlighting his evolution from employing Fabrício Queiroz in his office as a state deputy to his current role as senator, linking him to corruption schemes like the 'rachadinhas'. He is criticized for maintaining clientelistic and family-based practices, comparing him to a 'tupiniquim Tarantino' due to the controversial and violent style of his political actions. The narrative suggests continuity of illegal and authoritarian patterns within the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Pai de Vorcaro é preso em nova operação da PF sobre o caso Master
item.description: Henrique Vorcaro, father of banker Daniel Vorcaro, was arrested in a PF operation called Compliance Zero, investigating financial fraud, money laundering, and corruption at Banco Master. Authorities allege he benefited from funds deposited by his son and is part of a criminal organization suspected of threats, device intrusions, and breach of functional secrecy. The arrest came one day after The Intercept reported a $24 million deal between Daniel Vorcaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for a biopic on Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro: veja como imprensa internacional repercutiu o caso
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested and received R$ 61 million from imprisoned banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, with funds transferred to a U.S.-linked fund tied to Eduardo Bolsonaro. The revelations by Intercept Brasil, confirmed by Globo, triggered international coverage, notably by Clarín and Reuters, which highlight political fallout and potential market impacts, including threats to Flávio’s presidential ambitions. He denies wrongdoing and calls for a CPI on Banco Master.

item.title: Correligionários avaliam que vídeo de Zema atacando Flávio foi 'precoce'
item.description: Leaders from PL and Novo criticized Romeu Zema's video calling Flávio Bolsonaro's relationship with Daniel Vorcaro 'unforgivable' as premature and ill-timed, causing internal discomfort. The exclusive subscriber-only content was seen as inappropriate in the current political context.

item.title: Vorcaro 'esqueceu' de falar da relação com os Bolsonaros
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro omitted details about his plea bargain proposal concerning the financing of Jair Bolsonaro’s film and his contacts with Flávio Bolsonaro pressuring for fund transfers, increasing the assessment that the deal may be rejected as selective.

item.title: Repasse de Vorcaro a Flávio Bolsonaro banca 2 “O Agente Secreto”
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, allegedly transferred US$10.6 million (R$61 million) to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro — an amount sufficient to fund two productions of Kleber Mendonça Filho's 'O Agente Secreto'. The payment was negotiated directly by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, with intermediaries including Eduardo Bolsonaro and Mario Frias, and sent to the Havengate fund in Texas. Flávio denied wrongdoing, stating the support was a private sponsorship with no quid pro quo.

item.title: O que esperar do day after da revelação da relação entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: The revelation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's financial relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, involving a 61 million reais transfer to fund the film 'Dark Horse', has triggered a crisis in his PL presidential pre-candidacy. Flávio confirmed the request but denied wrongdoing, announcing interviews to counter the fallout, while Lula's allies seek to prolong the damage. New developments are expected in the coming days, including a potential CPI into Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro evita citar o 'irmão' Vorcaro em suas postagens sobre o Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoids mentioning his 'brother' Vorcaro in his posts about the Banco Master scandal, a strategy adopted since November 2025 to distance himself from the case. The discreet tactic aims to mitigate political damage by avoiding direct association with the individual involved in the scandal.

item.title: Como era o Brasil no ano do último título da seleção brasileira
item.description: In 2002, Brazil won its fifth World Cup title by defeating Germany 2-0, with both goals scored by Ronaldo. The country had 169 million inhabitants, 7.66% inflation, and 3.1% GDP growth that year. The victory was followed by the presidential transition from Fernando Henrique Cardoso to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, amid events such as the deaths of Chico Xavier and Claudinho, the Richthofen case, and the launch of the Nokia 6610.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, quinta, 14 de maio: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Thursday, May 14, 2026, there is a busy sports schedule featuring Copa do Brasil (second leg of the fifth round), La Liga, Saudi Pro League, and Campeonato Paulista Feminino matches. Key fixtures include Corinthians vs Barra-SC, CRB vs Fortaleza, and Vitória vs Flamengo in the Copa do Brasil, along with Mirassol vs Ferroviária, Red Bull Bragantino vs Corinthians, Santos vs Palmeiras, and São Paulo vs Taubaté in the women's Paulista Championship.

item.title: Alcolumbre e Múcio se encontram um dia após constrangimento em posse do TSE
item.description: One day after a tense atmosphere between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre during the TSE inauguration, Defense Minister José Múcio met for hours with the senator at the Senate's Official Residence. The meeting suggests efforts to ease political tensions following the incident at the electoral tribunal.

item.title: Preocupados, pré-candidatos do PL avaliam se desvincular de Flávio após diálogos com Vorcaro
item.description: PL pre-candidates are concerned and evaluating whether to distance themselves from Flávio Bolsonaro after the revelation of his dialogues with Daniel Vorcaro by Intercept Brasil, which surprised allies and caused internal discomfort. The exclusive subscriber-only article suggests these conversations could affect the party's electoral strategy in 2026.

item.title: Bolsonaro manda ficar firme e nega Michelle como opção, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed he spoke with his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, after an audio leak in which he requested funding for the film 'Dark Horse'. Jair Bolsonaro urged him to 'stand firm' and ruled out any possibility of Michelle Bolsonaro running for president in 2026. Flávio denied any wrongdoing in the film's financing, arguing that private funding is legitimate, unlike the use of public funds by the PT.

item.title: 'Crise de proporções ainda incalculáveis': como a imprensa internacional noticiou conversa de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: International media highlighted the conversation between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, in which the former admitted requesting funds to finance a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. According to The Intercept Brasil, the negotiated amount reached US$24 million, with R$61 million already disbursed between February and May 2025. Vorcaro is imprisoned over billion-dollar frauds at Banco Master and is negotiating a plea deal, while the scandal threatens Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign as the main opposition candidate in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Valor que Vorcaro deu a filme de Bolsonaro era 13 vezes o caixa do Master ao ser liquidado
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro paid R$62 million to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro’s political trajectory, an amount 13 times greater than the cash reserves of Banco Master when it was liquidated by the Central Bank in November 2023. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president from the PL party, allegedly sent audio messages to Vorcaro demanding funds for the film’s production, as reported exclusively by Intercept Brasil.
